resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a mandatory biometric update because candidates from a different parent Aadhaar were returned with no face match anywhere in the set and none of them holding an Aadhaar.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a first-time biometric update, which is de-duplicated like a fresh enrolment and must be free of matches to any other parent. Records under a different parent matched biometrically without any supporting face match, so the conflict could be neither confirmed nor cleared and the packet was rejected. A new packet with a complete, high-quality capture is needed to resolve the outstanding matches.
